f3_program: collection("john.purchased_puzzles", "puzzle", "john", source("John buys 3 puzzles"))
add("buy_puzzles", "john", at("john.purchased_puzzles.count", "current"), 3, source("John buys 3 puzzles"))
member("john.purchased_puzzles", "john.purchased_puzzles.first", source("The first puzzle"))
member("john.purchased_puzzles", "john.purchased_puzzles.second", source("The second and third puzzles"))
member("john.purchased_puzzles", "john.purchased_puzzles.third", source("The second and third puzzles"))
collection("john.purchased_puzzles.piece_counts", "piece_count", "john.purchased_puzzles", source("How many total pieces are all the puzzles"))
member("john.purchased_puzzles.piece_counts", "john.purchased_puzzles.first.pieces.count", source("The first puzzle has 1000 pieces"))
member("john.purchased_puzzles.piece_counts", "john.purchased_puzzles.second.pieces.count", source("The second and third puzzles have the same number of pieces"))
member("john.purchased_puzzles.piece_counts", "john.purchased_puzzles.third.pieces.count", source("The second and third puzzles have the same number of pieces"))
observe(at("john.purchased_puzzles.first.pieces.count", "current"), 1000, "count", source("The first puzzle has 1000 pieces"))
same(at("john.purchased_puzzles.second.pieces.count", "current"), at("john.purchased_puzzles.third.pieces.count", "current"), source("The second and third puzzles have the same number of pieces"))
percent_more(at("john.purchased_puzzles.second.pieces.count", "current"), at("john.purchased_puzzles.first.pieces.count", "current"), 50, source("each has 50% more pieces"))
percent_more(at("john.purchased_puzzles.third.pieces.count", "current"), at("john.purchased_puzzles.first.pieces.count", "current"), 50, source("each has 50% more pieces"))
query("sum", "john.purchased_puzzles.piece_counts", "current")
assumptions: The comparison in “each has 50% more pieces” refers to the first puzzle.

f3_program: collection("mitchell.book.pages_read_components", "page_count", "mitchell.book", source("the total number of pages that Mitchell had read altogether"))
observe(at("mitchell.book.full_chapters_read.count", "initial"), 10, "count", source("Mitchell had read ten chapters of a book before 4 o'clock"))
add("read_two_more_chapters", "mitchell", at("mitchell.book.full_chapters_read.count", "current"), 2, source("read 2 more chapters of the book"))
observe(at("mitchell.book.chapter_11.pages_read.count", "4_oclock"), 20, "count", source("Mitchell had read 20 pages of the 11th chapter"))
same(at("mitchell.book.chapter_11.pages_read.count", "current"), at("mitchell.book.chapter_11.pages_read.count", "4_oclock"), source("she didn't read the remaining pages of chapter eleven"))
observe(at("mitchell.book.pages_per_chapter", "current"), 40, "page_per_chapter", source("each chapter in the book had 40 pages"))

rate_relation(at("mitchell.book.full_chapters_read.pages.count", "current"), at("mitchell.book.pages_per_chapter", "current"), at("mitchell.book.full_chapters_read.count", "current"), source("each chapter in the book had 40 pages"))
member("mitchell.book.pages_read_components", "mitchell.book.full_chapters_read.pages.count", source("the total number of pages that Mitchell had read altogether"))
member("mitchell.book.pages_read_components", "mitchell.book.chapter_11.pages_read.count", source("the total number of pages that Mitchell had read altogether"))
query("sum", "mitchell.book.pages_read_components", "current")
collection("ariana.bills", "bill", "ariana", source("Ariana is past due on three bills"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("Ariana is past due on three bills"))
member("ariana.bills", "ariana.bills.first", source("The first bill"))
member("ariana.bills", "ariana.bills.second", source("The second bill"))
member("ariana.bills", "ariana.bills.last", source("The last bill"))
collection("ariana.bills.amounts_owed", "amount_owed", "ariana.bills", source("How much does Ariana owe in total"))
member("ariana.bills.amounts_owed", "ariana.bills.first.amount_owed", source("The first bill for $200"))
member("ariana.bills.amounts_owed", "ariana.bills.second.amount_owed", source("The second bill for $130"))
member("ariana.bills.amounts_owed", "ariana.bills.last.amount_owed", source("is for $444"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.first.amount_owed", "initial"), 200, "currency", source("The first bill for $200"))
percent_of(at("ariana.bills.first.simple_interest.per_month.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.first.amount_owed", "initial"), 10, source("charges 10% simple interest for each overdue month"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.first.overdue_duration", "current"), 2, "month", source("it's 2 months overdue"))

rate_relation(at("ariana.bills.first.simple_interest.total.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.first.simple_interest.per_month.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.first.overdue_duration", "current"), source("charges 10% simple interest for each overdue month and it's 2 months overdue"))

add("first_bill_interest_charge", "ariana.bills.first", at("ariana.bills.first.amount_owed", "current"), at("ariana.bills.first.simple_interest.total.amount", "current"), source("The first bill for $200 charges 10% simple interest for each overdue month and it's 2 months overdue"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.second.amount_owed", "initial"), 130, "currency", source("The second bill for $130"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.second.late_fee.per_month.amount", "current"), 50, "currency_per_month", source("charges a flat $50 late fee per month"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.second.overdue_duration", "current"), 6, "month", source("is 6 months overdue"))

rate_relation(at("ariana.bills.second.late_fee.total.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.second.late_fee.per_month.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.second.overdue_duration", "current"), source("charges a flat $50 late fee per month and is 6 months overdue"))

add("second_bill_late_fee_charge", "ariana.bills.second", at("ariana.bills.second.amount_owed", "current"), at("ariana.bills.second.late_fee.total.amount", "current"), source("The second bill for $130 charges a flat $50 late fee per month and is 6 months overdue"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.last.amount_owed", "initial"), 444, "currency", source("is for $444"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.last.overdue_duration", "current"), 2, "month", source("The last bill is two months late"))
observe(at("ariana.bills.last.first_month_fee.amount", "current"), 40, "currency", source("charges a $40 fee the first month overdue"))
multiple(at("ariana.bills.last.second_month_fee.amount", "current"), at("ariana.bills.last.first_month_fee.amount", "current"), 2, source("twice that fee the second month overdue"))

add("last_bill_first_month_fee", "ariana.bills.last", at("ariana.bills.last.amount_owed", "current"), at("ariana.bills.last.first_month_fee.amount", "current"), source("charges a $40 fee the first month overdue"))

add("last_bill_second_month_fee", "ariana.bills.last", at("ariana.bills.last.amount_owed", "current"), at("ariana.bills.last.second_month_fee.amount", "current"), source("twice that fee the second month overdue"))
query("sum", "ariana.bills.amounts_owed", "current")
